summary: This plan addresses the security vulnerabilities identified by the Security Agent. The main issues are a hardcoded MongoDB fallback credential in lib/mongodb.ts and dangerous use of dangerouslySetInnerHTML in app/login-and-signup/page.tsx that bypasses React's escaping.

files.rationale: Remove the hardcoded FALLBACK_MONGODB_URI to eliminate the CWE-798 vulnerability by ensuring only environment variables are used for database connection
Replace dangerouslySetInnerHTML with plain text rendering to prevent XSS/SQL injection vulnerabilities (CWE-79)
